description: Open a new tab, optionally at a URL, and make it the implicit target of later commands in this session. Each call creates another tab: reuse a tab_id or navigate() to move an existing one instead of piling up tabs.

active.description: false opens the tab in the background, leaving the current one focused

left.description: Window x on the virtual desktop (new_window)

new_window.description: Open in a fresh window instead of a tab; with left/top it lands on the chosen monitor

url.description: URL to open (default: new tab page)

name: create_tab
